data.name: Biplab
data.gender_notes: Biplab is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Biplab is a Sanskrit name derived from the words ‘bip’ meaning struggle or battle, and ‘labh’ meaning to gain or acquire. This name signifies the struggle one undergoes to achieve success or gain something valuable. The name Biplab carries the meaning “Struggle, Battle” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Biplab usually hope their child will grow to embody struggle, battle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name representing the inner battle one faces on the spiritual path.
data.etymology: Biplab belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Struggle, Battle.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Biplab total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
